title: Ghar Ek Mandir
desc: A heartfelt family drama exploring relationships, traditions, and moral values. Set around a temple, it weaves stories of love, sacrifice, and togetherness that bind generations under one roof.

title: Kshatriya
desc: In Rajasthan, two royal families clash over their annual buffalo sacrifice ritual after one parent returns from England opposed to it. Years later, their kids' reunion might mend the divide.

title: Ramkali
desc: Sultan, an inspector turned fugitive bandit, teams up with dancer Ramkali alias Raksha to seek revenge on Shankar Singh.

title: Naajayaz
desc: A police officer, ready to arrest a gang leader who is his father, is pulled off the case, forcing a conflict between duty and family ties.

title: Taqdeerwala

title: Take 2 Extraaa
desc: Take 2 Extraaa of 'Piku': Dive into the heartwarming bond of father-daughter in this adorable tale's behind-the-scenes.
